projects.name: Global Mutual Fund Onboarding
details: Leading complete business analysis and solution design for onboarding global mutual funds into India's international
investment ecosystem through India INX.
• Led end-to-end onboarding journey design for Global Mutual Funds, coordinating across domestic and international
stakeholders.
• Gathered and documented business requirements from internal and external stakeholders through structured workshops
and interviews.
• Prepared BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, RTM, Process Flows, and supporting business
documentation.
• Designed the Investor Onboarding Journey and Distributor / Sub-Distributor onboarding workflows.
• Defined KYC, AML, and Due Diligence processes for investor onboarding.
• Designed Order Aggregation logic for Purchase, Redemption, and Switch transactions.
• Designed end-to-end Fund Flow across Investors, Distributors, Standard Chartered Bank, India INX, JP Morgan,
EBIX, and Global Fund Houses.
• Led API integration efforts with Calastone and multiple external systems.
• Designed Holdings Allocation process through EBIX and defined Order Management workflows.
• Designed reconciliation processes covering Order, Fund, Holdings, and Unit Allocation reconciliation.
• Prepared comprehensive UAT test cases and supported SIT/UAT execution.
• Coordinated with Technology, Operations, Compliance, Product, and Business teams; managed production issues,
defect resolution, and change requests.
• Participated in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, and
Retrospectives.
Key Achievements
• Successfully designed the complete end-to-end onboarding journey for Global Mutual Funds onto India INX.
• Delivered business analysis for onboarding BlackRock Global Mutual Funds, a flagship regulatory and platform
initiative.
• Reduced manual operational effort through targeted process automation, improving overall workflow efficiency.
• Delivered complete functional documentation across multiple business modules, supporting scalable platform delivery.
